pr.title: Return value of coroutine_layout fn changed to Result with LayoutError
pr.description:
<!-- homu-ignore:start -->
<!--
https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/126482

    r? oli-obk
-->
<!-- homu-ignore:end -->

Continue of https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/140902:
`coroutine_layout` fn is now returns `Result` with `LayoutError` to have consistent error with `layout_of_uncached`.
`async_drop_coroutine_layout` fn is now return `LayoutError::TooGeneric` in case of not-fully-specialized `async_drop_in_place<T>::{closure}` coroutine.
pr.author: azhogin

analysis.originalLogic: `coroutine_layout` and its helpers returned `Option<&CoroutineLayout>`, where `None` meant the layout was unavailable. `async_drop_coroutine_layout` explicitly returned `None` when `args[0].has_placeholders() || args[0].has_non_region_param()`, and `layout_of_uncached` converted any `None` into `Err(error(cx, LayoutError::Unknown(ty)))`. In `Validator`, the layout lookup was `self.caller_body.coroutine_layout_raw().or_else(|| self.tcx.coroutine_layout(def_id, args))`, with the same query used as another fallback arm.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: The historical behavior being corrected is an error-representation collapse: a not-fully-specialized `async_drop_in_place<T>::{closure}` coroutine returned `None`, which `layout_of_uncached` surfaced as `LayoutError::Unknown`, losing the distinction from other unavailable layouts. The replacement returns `Err(LayoutError::TooGeneric(ty()))` for placeholder or non-region-parameter arguments, while other missing raw layouts become `Err(LayoutError::Unknown(ty()))`. Callers that only need an optional layout, such as `Validator`, must adapt with `.ok()` rather than treating every `Err` as invalid MIR.
analysis.inputDomain: Coroutine types and their layouts, especially async-drop coroutines for `async_drop_in_place<T>::{closure}` with generic/placeholder or non-region parameters, ordinary coroutines whose MIR may be tainted by errors, and coroutine-closures including by-move body layouts. A focused pair can specialize `T` in an async-drop coroutine versus leave `T` generic/placeholder.
analysis.summary: A 2024-era Rust PR migrates `TyCtxt::coroutine_layout` and its helpers from `Option` to `Result<_, &LayoutError>`. The important reusable invariant is that failure reasons are now explicit: not-fully-specialized async-drop coroutine arguments yield `LayoutError::TooGeneric`, while a missing raw coroutine layout yields `LayoutError::Unknown`. `Validator` intentionally converts the `Result` back to an option with `.ok()` because layout unavailability is advisory there, preserving its raw-layout fallback behavior.
analysis.trigger: Querying the layout of a coroutine whose arguments are not fully specialized, or whose optimized MIR has no raw coroutine layout, while running MIR validation or layout computation.
preconditions: The queried type is a coroutine, including async-drop coroutines and coroutine-closure by-move bodies.
For the TooGeneric case, the async-drop coroutine's first generic argument has placeholders or a non-region parameter.
For the Unknown case, `coroutine_layout_raw()` returns no layout, e.g. MIR tainted by errors.
Validator must still be able to skip checking a layout it cannot obtain.
pitfalls: Do not unwrap or propagate `coroutine_layout` errors from `Validator`; its existing behavior is to fall back to `caller_body.coroutine_layout_raw()` and then to no layout.
Do not collapse `TooGeneric` back into `Unknown`: the PR explicitly separates them.
Preserve the raw-layout preference for the caller body and for the by-move body of a coroutine-closure before querying `coroutine_layout`.
Treat an unavailable layout as a skipped validation check, not automatically as an invalid-MIR finding.
analysis.testStrategy: Add compile/UI coverage with an async-drop coroutine whose `T` remains generic or placeholder-bearing and verify no ICE plus the intended TooGeneric error path; compare against a fully specialized variant. Exercise coroutine-closures, including by-move bodies, and error-tainted coroutines to cover Unknown. For `Validator`, assert validation continues safely when `coroutine_layout` returns `Err`, while retaining raw-layout checking for the current body. Unit-level assertions can distinguish `Err(TooGeneric)` from `Err(Unknown)` rather than merely checking that layout lookup failed.
evidence: `coroutine_layout` fn is now returns `Result` with `LayoutError` to have consistent error with `layout_of_uncached`.
`async_drop_coroutine_layout` fn is now return `LayoutError::TooGeneric` in case of not-fully-specialized `async_drop_in_place<T>::{closure}` coroutine.
